emoji.description: Icon emoji. Use the requested emoji or a relevant one.

frequency_unit.description: A Task is one-time: frequency_unit=OneTime in create tools, stored as null, with due_date and requested due_time. A dated event or single dated instruction is a Task unless repetition was requested. A Habit has Day, Week, Month or Year and a positive frequency_quantity. Daily weekdays require Day/1; is_flexible tracks a quantity within a window and cannot have weekdays. General items have no schedule, recurrence or avoid type. end_date is inclusive and only recurring items use it. A temporary instruction for N days before an event uses one Task per day or a recurring Habit with end_date equal to the event date. Never leave temporary preparation recurring indefinitely.

frequency_quantity.description: How often (e.g. every 2 days). Defaults to 1.

interval_weeks.description: Repeat interval in weeks. Omit for every week. Minimum 1.

days.description: Recurring weekdays with Day and quantity 1; Week with quantity 1 normalizes to Day. Null for one-time tasks.

due_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD. One-time due date or recurrence start. Defaults to today.

end_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Optional end date. Habit stops appearing after this date. Only for recurring habits.

due_time.description: HH:mm start time. Omit when there is only a deadline.

due_end_time.description: HH:mm end time or deadline. For 'before 15h' without a fixed start, set 15:00 and omit due_time.

is_general.description: General habit without a schedule. Children inherit this value.

relative_reminders.description: Reminders relative to due_time: minutes_before, or when (day_before/same_day) and time (HH:mm). Empty array clears them.

is_bad_habit.description: Use is_bad_habit=true only for ongoing reduction or slip tracking, named for the behaviour itself: Fumar, Tomar multivitamínico, Smoking, Drinking soda. For quero parar de fumar or I want to drink less soda, choose that avoid form. A temporary or dated abstinence is a positive commitment, is_bad_habit=false, named Não tomar multivitamínico or Don't take multivitamins, once or within its explicit date range. Never combine an avoid type with a negated name: não, sem, parar de, evitar, don't, stop, avoid.

is_flexible.description: True for window-based tracking (e.g. '3x per week, any days'). Cannot have days set. Requires frequency_unit.

slip_alert_enabled.description: Enable slip pattern alerts. Defaults to true for bad habits.

reminder_times.description: Minutes before due time to remind (e.g. [15, 60])

tag_names.description: Tag names to assign. Existing tags reused, new ones created.

checklist_items.description: Steps done together, such as shopping, prep or packing lists. Independent activities use sub_habits.

scheduled_reminders.description: Absolute reminders when due_time is absent. Use instead of reminder_times.

goal_ids.description: IDs of goals to link this habit to

sub_habits.description: Children with independent schedules or streaks. Steps done together use checklist_items.

frequency_unit.description: Override parent recurrence. Use OneTime for a one-time task; null inherits. Otherwise the parent's unit and quantity are inherited.

days.description: Recurring weekdays with Day (or Week normalized to Day) and quantity 1. Omit for dated one-time tasks.

due_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Child start date without inherited weekdays. Use OneTime for a one-time child.

relative_reminders.description: Reminders relative to due_time: minutes_before, or when (day_before/same_day) and time (HH:mm). Empty array clears them.

scheduled_reminders.description: Absolute-time reminders for habits WITHOUT a due_time
